name: Ahikam
bio: Ahikam son of Shaphan was one of five officials King Josiah sent, along with Hilkiah, Achbor, Shaphan his own father, and Asahiah, to consult Huldah the prophetess about the newly found book of the law and its warnings against Judah (2 Kings 22:12-14). His continued role as a royal official is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
